from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class CompanyExpense(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial expense data for a single company from one document."""
    company_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="The name of the company the filing belongs to")
    period: Optional[str] = Field(description="The reporting period for the figures (e.g., 'Three months ended March 31, 2024')")
    expense_label: Optional[str] = Field(description="The exact line item label used in the statement for operating/admin costs")
    amount: Optional[float] = Field(description="The numerical amount of the expense")
    unit: Optional[str] = Field(description="The scale of the amount, e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    expenses: List[CompanyExpense]
